profile.introductionEn: I am a master's student in Energy and Power Engineering at the University of Science and Technology of China, working at the KMAX Laboratory on plasma physics, diagnostics, space-environment observations, and scientific computing

focus: 科研计算与数据可视化
focusDetails: 关注等离子体中的输运、结构与实验诊断方法
关注空间环境观测、流星雷达数据分析及相关反演问题
使用 C、Python、Fortran、Julia 和科学计算工具完成数据处理与结果表达
使用代码完成数据处理、计算结果表达与科研图形制作
探索 Agent 在科学研究辅助中的可靠用法
focusDetailsEn: Interested in plasma transport, structures, and experimental diagnostic methods
Studying space-environment observations, meteor-radar data, and related inverse problems
Using C, Python, Fortran, Julia, and scientific-computing tools for data processing and communication
Using code for data processing, computational communication, and scientific visualization
Exploring reliable uses of agents in scientific research
